nodes.question: How can employment reduction from reduced mobility demand and conventional vehicle manufacturing be compensated for in other sectors?
nodes.answer: Employment reduction from reduced mobility demand and conventional vehicle manufacturing can be compensated for in other sectors through a farsighted qualification strategy that ensures the transition of employees between sectors to meet skill demands and regional scopes.
